WORKSHEET · MATCHING & SORTING · AGE 2

Sort Flying and Rolling Worksheet

A printable sorting worksheet for toddlers: six things sorted into the Fly box and the Roll box by how they move — on paper or on screen.

THE WORKSHEET

The full sheet, exactly as the artist drew it.

See the whole picture, download the original file or print it clean — just the picture, no buttons or banners. Want to solve it right now on this screen? Solve it online — same picture, drawing layer included.

← Day & NightPrevious worksheetLiving & Nonliving →Next worksheet
HOW TO USE IT

Three little steps.

  1. 1

    Name them and move

    Flap like the bird, roll your arms like the car!

  2. 2

    Ask the question

    Does it fly in the air, or roll on the ground?

  3. 3

    Sort them

    Draw the flying things into the Fly box, the rolling things into the Roll box.
